dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular, closed 'O' and semi-closed 'C' shaped light-gray loops are distributed across the dorsal surface. The most prominent 'O' structure on the upper-left flank displays a jagged, high-contrast perimeter with a sharp gradient transition from the dark exterior to a light-gray interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, irregularly shaped, solid light-intensity pixel clusters localized along the upper dorsal ridge and far-left neck region, characterized by a lack of internal gradient or core darkening.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: An obtuse triangle is formed by connecting the centroid of the prominent 'O' annuli on the upper-left flank with the centroid of a secondary 'C' shape to its right and a dense cluster of blobs directly superior on the ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: A large, elongated, amorphous light-intensity pattern with wispy, non-uniform edges stretches horizontally across the lower-right quadrant of the visible flank.
